note: What a server sends to put the match on hold.

fields.name: seat
fields.note: The seat that called the hold.

fields.name: timeLeft
fields.note: How long the hold may run, in seconds.

bits.name: unlimited
bits.note: Set where the hold runs under tournament terms and does not expire on its own.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. A server leaves these as it found them, so they carry values it never wrote for this message.
